counterbalanced_definition.a_candidate_order: native LO antisymmetric in the pair -> order swap on cached scores is the identity; counterbalance applied to the per-candidate bias
counterbalanced_definition.paired_states: s_cb = s - 1/2 [s + s(partner)] in the fixed candidate frame = 1/2 (lo_self^key + lo_partner^key); D1 partner = other version; D2 partner = mirror planted state (see 'details')
counterbalanced_definition.D1_note: coincides with X6 CENTRED D1 (pair mean of the toward-own-key LOs) up to the factor 1/2: identical signs
counterbalanced_definition.D3: leave-one-out additive bias over the other items of the same set family: puzzles per-symbol (fit_pair_bias), choice option-position; never fitted on the scored item

D1.pairing: the two natural states of the pair (versions A and B)

D2_astar.pairing: planted state (source A -> B at its alpha*) with the mirror planted state of the same pair (source B -> A at its alpha*)

D2_alpha1.pairing: planted state (source A -> B at alpha 1) with the mirror planted state (source B -> A at alpha 1)

counterbalanced_definition.b_query_direction: n/a: none of the X templates encodes a query direction
counterbalanced_definition.c_label_tokens: n/a: no template uses label tokens (candidates are answered by their own words / symbols)
counterbalanced_definition.z2b: true swapped-batch-order re-scoring needs reader forward passes (Oracle lens and NLA run on 27B models): deferred to Z2b (pod, <= 30 min, 297 D3 ERROR + 126 D2 states, reader side only, read vectors cached)

verdict.writeup: X6 inversion on D3 ERROR does not survive the counterbalanced scoring: downgrade to 'suggestive' in writeup.md (Phase Z corrections)

puzzle.centred: lo_actual minus a 5-fold least-squares additive symbol bias b[actual] - b[other] (per reader)
puzzle.probe: 5-fold L2 multinomial logistic over the symbol vocabulary; score = (w[actual] - w[other]) . h + db

choice.centred: not centrable (unique words per item): CENTRED = RAW
choice.probe: 5-fold L2 binary logistic on 'actual == first-listed option', oriented toward the actual answer (the multinomial over the choice vocabulary is reported for coverage only)

D2.centred: lo_toward_other(planted) - lo_toward_other(natural state of the same source) = X2 E6 shift
